// Fixture: popup events with weighted outcomes, shaped like src/game/events/era-pack-1980-events.ts.
// The outcome objects use the short keys t (title), x (what happened) and l (life-log line).

import { eraPrice } from './era-late-kit'
import type { EraEventSpec } from './era-late-kit'

const SPECS: EraEventSpec[] = [

        outs: [
          {

            x: (_g, x) => `${x.p?.firstName ?? 'Nobody you know'} said nobody was looking.`,

          },

      { id: 'walk', label: 'Nobody wins anything here', outs: [{ t: 'Walked Away', x: 'You kept your coins.', l: null }] },
